name: @sovereign/desktop
description: Self-hosted Windows desktop control plane for the Sovereign Code Runtime.
author: Sovereign Code Runtime contributors

scripts.bundle: pnpm bundle:runtime-host && pnpm bundle:main && pnpm bundle:preload && pnpm bundle:approval-preload && pnpm bundle:renderer
scripts.start: pnpm build:native && pnpm prepare:runtime && pnpm bundle && electron-forge start
scripts.visual:test: pnpm bundle && pnpm bundle:visual && node scripts/run-electron-visual.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm build:native && pnpm prepare:runtime && pnpm bundle && electron-forge package
scripts.make: pnpm build:native && pnpm prepare:runtime && pnpm bundle && electron-forge make && node scripts/smoke-packaged.mjs && node scripts/prune-artifacts.mjs
